evidence.title: Infographics. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Infographics.
summary: Step-by-step guide to making infographics with AI in Claude, including the full copy-paste prompt.
description: Ruben Hassid's guide to making infographics with AI in Claude: upload reference images, paste a design-lead prompt that extracts a design system, writes DESIGN_SYSTEM.md and builds a tokens preview, then generate the infographic from your information. Includes the full prompt and a screenshot walkthrough; later sections are for paid subscribers.
